reason: Actual BC1 and BC3 compressed-block90degree rotation exactly matches independent GPU-coordinate rotation for every RGBA texel, including both alpha endpoint orders. Omitted selector rotation gives wrong output, partial-block extent rejects, asynchronous stale-owner result rejects; all GPU resources close. Nine paired32request jobs include fresh zlib inflate, transform/upload/submit/fullreadback/cleanup; prepared device/pipelines shared. Median cost ratio0.9953, bootstrap95[0.4968,1.5714] fails reliable-gain gate. Raw block bytes64/128 remainunchanged in size; explicit zlib input66/127bytes. No general texture-video-container or network claim.
next_action: Research profile complete; revisit only with an actual consumer requiring rewritten blocks rather than cheaper coordinate rotation, or larger representative workloads.
